text: This is a timed, mixed-domain practice set — the first half of a full mock exam split across this lesson and the next. Nothing new is taught here; it's nine questions back-to-back.
Set a timer for about eighteen to twenty minutes before you start. Answer all nine questions first, then review every explanation in one pass at the end — exactly how the real exam works.

Domain 1 questions on Lakehouse versus Warehouse and Direct Lake Mode. Domain 2 questions on Eventstream ingestion and a Delta merge pattern. Domain 3 questions on narrowest-control and monitoring-versus-deployment.
After finishing, score yourself, then sort your misses by domain. If misses cluster in one domain, that's the signal to go back to that domain's chapter.
One mixed-domain set down. Next up: the second half — different questions, same format, completing the full mock exam.
